query:
-- Doublons par lotus_id (même identifiant LOTUS assigné à plusieurs molécules)
SELECT lotus_id, COUNT(*) as nb, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ',') as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') as names
FROM molecules
WHERE lotus_id IS NOT NULL AND lotus_id != ''
GROUP BY lotus_id
HAVING nb > 1
ORDER BY nb DESC
LIMIT 30;
